descriptions.zh:
在观察§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!当地人口时，我们的外派团队发现了件有趣的事情。

这里的首都大街小巷都在交头接耳着关于一位“天选之人”的事情，据说是从星间下凡实现一个古老预言，并将带领[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]走入下一个黄金时期。

我们的所有人员都记录在岗，所以究竟是谁在访问这颗行星很值得进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
While observing the local population of §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!, our away team have come across an interesting discovery.

The capital city is abuzz with talk of a "Chosen One" who has reportedly descended from the stars to fulfill an ancient prophecy and lead the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] into a new golden age.

All of our personnel are accounted for, so whoever it is that is visiting this planet, they are worth investigating further.

descriptions.zh: 我们的外派团队正在§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!深入调查所谓“天选之人”来揭开他的真面目。
descriptions.en: Our away team's investigation into the "Chosen One" on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! has revealed their true identity.

descriptions.zh: 一位§Y拿玛拉流浪汉§!伪装成了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话的核心人物，“从星间下凡而来”。
descriptions.en: A §YNamaraian Nomad§! is masquerading as the central figure of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology, having "descended from the stars".

descriptions.zh: 一位§Y[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]§!流浪者伪装成了[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话的核心人物，“从星间下凡而来”。
descriptions.en: A §Y[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]§! caravaneer is masquerading as the central figure of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology, having "descended from the stars".

descriptions.zh:
在行星上的进一步探索中发现了他把坠毁的舰船隐藏在了一片离首都一段距离无法到达的峡谷。根据其老旧的超空间引擎型号，此人可能已经到此有些年头了。

自从落难到此，他似乎开始利用当地的迷信来牟利。他被任命为充满“天智”的统治者，心安理得地开始接受当地人的顶礼膜拜。

如果放任不管，这个骗子在行星上的存在很可能对社会的发展造成严重的影响，最好还是介入处置一下。
descriptions.en:
Further exploration of the planet has revealed their crashed and inoperable ship hidden in an inaccessible valley some distance away from the capital. Based on the dated model of the hyperdrives, they have been here for some time.

Since becoming marooned, they appear to have been using the local superstition to their advantage. They happily accept veneration and praise from the locals having been installed as their ruler full of "celestial knowledge".

If left unchecked, this charlatan's presence on the planet will likely have heavy consequences for the developing society. It might be best to intervene.

label.en: Expose them as the fraud they are.

descriptions.zh: 我们揭露了§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上那个伪装成[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话中“天选之人”的§Y拿玛拉流浪汉§!。
descriptions.en: We have successfully deposed the §YNamaraian Nomad§! on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! masquerading as the "Chosen One" of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology.

descriptions.zh: 我们揭露了§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上那个伪装成[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]神话中“天选之人”的§Y[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]§!。
descriptions.en: We have successfully deposed the §Y[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]§! on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! masquerading as the "Chosen One" of the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] mythology.

descriptions.zh:
在进一步调查当地的传说之后，我们告诉他们所谓天选之人的统治阶级事实上是一位被派来欺骗他们的恶魔，将会给这个世界带来千年之久的黑暗。

我们将坠毁的舰船完全拆成了碎片，让当地人无迹可寻。然而，有些个人物品已经被发现了，该物种也窥见了超过当前理解水平的科技。
descriptions.en:
After researching local legends in more detail, we were able to convince the ruling class that their so-called chosen one was in fact a demon sent to deceive them and plunge the planet into a thousand years of darkness.

We successfully scrapped the crashed ship for parts, leaving no trace of it for the locals to find. However, some personal items had already been discovered and have given this species a glimpse of technology beyond their current understanding.

descriptions.zh: 我们的外派团队获得了与§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的所谓“天选之人”私下见面的机会，提出为其修复舰船并送回太空的机会。
descriptions.en: Our away team was able to gain a private audience with the "Chosen One" of §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! and offer them our services in repairing their ship and returning them to space.

descriptions.zh: 那个§Y拿玛拉流浪汉§!急切地想要接受我们的邀请，不断辩称是在搁浅于§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的时候被误认为是神，之后因惧怕事情败露后遭到伤害而惶惶不可终日。
descriptions.en: The §YNamarain Nomad§! was all too eager to accept the offer, explaining that they'd been mistakenly received as a god after becoming stranded on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! and had lived in fear of being harmed if unmasked ever since.

descriptions.zh: 那个§Y[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]§!急切地想要接受我们的邀请，不断辩称是在搁浅于§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的时候被误认为是神，之后因惧怕事情败露后遭到伤害而惶惶不可终日。
descriptions.en: The §Y[event_target:caravaneer_fleet3_country.GetSpeciesName]§! was all too eager to accept the offer, explaining that they'd been mistakenly received as a god after becoming stranded on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! and had lived in fear of being harmed if unmasked ever since.

descriptions.zh:
将其送到了我们的研究站修复了舰船之后，这位充满感激的旅行者将舰船库存的一大部分东西送给了我们并向我们郑重道别。

因为其离去而造成的权利真空在§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的各个教派之间引发了一场短暂但血腥的斗争，现在也趋于平息。
descriptions.en:
Having transported them to our research post and repaired their ship, the grateful traveler gifted us with a large portion of their vessel's inventory before bidding us farewell.

The ensuing power vacuum created by their departure triggered a brief but brutal struggle between various religious sects on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!, which has now subsided.

descriptions.zh:
你好[Owner.GetSpeciesName]。我们了解到你们刚刚处理了一个脱离我们舰队的拿玛拉人流氓。

你们可帮了大忙。这个误入歧途的人一直让人讨厌，他的疯狂野心给我们的旅程带来了风险。

请收下这份礼物作为感谢。
descriptions.en:
Greetings [Owner.GetSpeciesName]. We understand that you have dealt with a rogue Namarian who separated from our fleet.

You have done us a service. This misguided individual was a constant annoyance, their wild ambitions posing a risk to our journey.

Please, take this gift as thanks.

descriptions.zh:
[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]处理了我们弄丢的§Y垃圾§!？你们人还怪好的！这个蠢货除了麻烦什么都造不出来。至于他说的那些鬼话？真遗憾，他这都是第五次了。真的？我们很高兴他滚蛋了。
这个你收下，这是给你们处理了个麻烦玩意儿的谢礼。一锤子买卖，非常好东西。
descriptions.en:
[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] dealt with the lost §YRacket§!? Very good of you! This fool caused nothing but headaches for us. His mumbo jumbo? An embarrassment. It's the fifth time this has happened. Honestly? We're glad they're gone.
Here, you take this, a gift for making the problem go away. One time deal, very good value.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!轨道上的观测站汇报，在最近一次地表地址调查之后丢失了一个补给箱。

在追踪补给箱地理定位的过程中，我们发现它被一座当地村庄发现并占为己有。

我们补给箱的混入可能对[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]社会的发展带来不利影响。
descriptions.en:
Our observation post above §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! has reported missing supply crates following a recent geological survey on the surface.

While tracking the geolocators on the supplies, we have discovered that a local village has found and claimed these resources for themselves.

The introduction of our storage containers may have an adverse effect on the development of [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

descriptions.zh:
看来，误入§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的补给箱存对当地文化产生了奇怪的影响。

当地[Root.GetPreFTLUpper]居民建造了我们观测飞船的粗糙仿制品。虽然这些“船”显然没有功能，但这证明我们的研究人员在调查期间被当地人发现了。

在一位当地长老的指导下，可以看到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]队模仿我们的地质土壤分析程序：把我们不当处置的板条箱装满泥土和岩石，把它们装上他们的“船”，耐心地等待。
descriptions.en:
It would appear that the misplaced inventory on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! has had a strange impact on the native culture.

The [Root.GetPreFTLUpper] population has built crude imitations of our own observation shuttles. While these "ships" are obviously non functional, this is evidence that our researchers were spotted by locals during their survey.

Under the guidance of a local elder, the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] can be seen performing an imitation of our geological soil analysis procedure: filling our misplaced crates we left behind with dirt and rocks, loading them onto their "ships", and waiting patiently.

descriptions.zh: [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]以为模仿我们的行为，就会有更多的货物出现。我们应该在这种行为对社会造成更大影响之前进行干预。
descriptions.en: The [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] are under the impression that by mimicking our processes, more supplies will appear. We should intervene before this behavior impacts their wider society.

descriptions.zh: 这么做就是徒劳，等来的只会有死亡。
descriptions.en: This practice is ultimately futile, only death awaits.

label.zh: 用食物交换他们的矿物。
label.en: Exchange food supplies for their minerals.

tooltips.zh: 正在观测§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的观测站将产出$@observation_outpost_crate_minerals_production$£minerals£§I矿物§!，维护费$@observation_outpost_crate_food_upkeep$£food£§I食物§!
tooltips.en: The Observation post currently observing §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! now produces $@observation_outpost_crate_minerals_production$ £minerals£ §IMinerals§! with an upkeep of $@observation_outpost_crate_food_upkeep$ £food£ §IFood§!

descriptions.zh:
从§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!取回我们丢失的箱子后，装载“飞船”的仪式仍持续了一阵子，直到[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]愤怒地找到村庄长老，然后把他们丢进仿造的“穿梭机”并烧成了灰烬。

尽管人们已经回归了此前的日常，但他们的文化里对“天人”的怨恨仍然挥之不去。
descriptions.en:
After recovering our lost crates from §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!, the "ship" loading rituals continued for a short while, until the angry [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] locals turned on their village elder, throwing them into the makeshift shuttle before burning it to ashes.

Although the population has returned to their previous routines, their culture retains a lingering resentment towards the "sky people".

descriptions.zh:
随着[Root.GetPreFTLLower][event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName]社会的发展，我们停止了从观测站与他们进行的资源交换。

尽管这是一个很有趣的实验，继续影响他们的社会只会让我们过早地暴露在他们面前。
descriptions.en:
As the [Root.GetPreFTLLower] [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesName] society advances, we have discontinued our exchange of rations for minerals from our observation post.

Despite being an interesting experiment, the continued interference with their civilization only risks exposing our presence to them prematurely.

tooltips.zh: 该观测站不再产出矿物也不需要食物维护费了
tooltips.en: The Observation post no longer outputs Minerals and no longer requires a Food upkeep

descriptions.zh:
一阵重力异常将我们的观测站晃离了§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的轨道，导致它短暂进入了行星的下层大气。

虽然我们的乘员没有受伤而且也恢复了原定轨道，但有人担心观测站可能会被地上的[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发现。

只有时间知道我们是否暴露，以及这会对他们的社会造成何等影响。
descriptions.en:
A gravitational anomaly knocked our observation post over §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! out of orbit, causing it to briefly drop into the planet's lower atmosphere.

While our crew are unharmed and our original trajectory has been restored, there are concerns that the station could have been detected from the surface by the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Only time will tell if we have been exposed to the locals, and to what extent that will impact their society.

descriptions.zh:
我们的观测站在落入§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!下层轨道时被原始的成像科技记录了下来。除了目击证据，这些照片也启发了一些国家建造“登天之梯”以进一步调查研究。

尽管这是徒劳，各个民族国家之间的竞争导致了不稳定。在民族自豪感和资源稀缺的推动下，在完成第一个“阶梯”的竞赛中，旧有的紧张关系重新燃起。
descriptions.en:
Primitive image capturing technology managed to record our observation post while it was in low orbit above §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!. Alongside eyewitness testimonies, these photographs have inspired some nations to build "ladders to heaven" in order to investigate further.

While this is obviously a futile effort, competition between nation states is having a destabilizing effect. Old tensions are flaring up in the race to complete the first "ladder", fueled by national pride and scarcity of resources.

descriptions.zh:
如果我们能销毁他们关于我们存在的证据，那也许能在失控之前缓和紧张局势。

这种[Root.GetPreFTLUpper]政治实体之间的外交姿态也可以作为一个很有趣的社会学研究案例，尽管它还有可能成为暴力升级的导火索。
descriptions.en:
If we can discredit their evidence of our own existence, we may be able to defuse tensions before the situation gets out of [Owner.GetSpeciesHandName].

Alternatively, this diplomatic posturing between [Root.GetPreFTLUpper] political powers could be an interesting sociological case study, albeit one that comes with the risk of violent escalation.

descriptions.zh: 即将到来的混乱应该是一个极好的研究机会。
descriptions.en: The impending chaos should make for an excellent research opportunity.

tooltips.zh: 观测站的£society£§Y社会学§!研究产出翻倍
tooltips.en: The £society£ §YSociety§! Research output from the observation post is doubled

descriptions.zh:
我们的特工已经成功地推翻了我们在§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上存在的证据。

随着图像被揭穿，目击者的可信度被毁，“通天之梯”的建设已经停止。这两个曾经分裂的国家为自己被认为愚蠢而感到尴尬，他们已承诺追求理性的探索和科学的方法。

随着新一波学者聚集在一起，“天空城堡”神话的面纱被揭开，梯子的建筑工地已被改造成了高等教育中心。
descriptions.en:
Our operators have successfully discredited the evidence of our existence on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!.

With the images debunked and the eyewitnesses' credibility destroyed, construction of the "ladders to heaven" has stopped. Embarrassed by their perceived foolishness, the once-divided nations have made a commitment towards the pursuit of rational inquiry and the scientific method.

The building sites for the ladders have been repurposed into centers of higher learning, as a new wave of scholars come together to debunk the myths of the "Sky Citadel".

tooltips.zh:
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName]向下一个时代进展50%
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName]成为唯物主义。
tooltips.en:
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName] makes 50% progress towards the next age
[event_target:pre_ftl_country.GetName] becomes Materialist.

descriptions.zh:
在建设“通天之梯”的过程中，§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上的[Root.GetPreFTLLower]国家之间的紧张局势导致了一场席卷全球的冲突。为了争夺日益减少的资源，这场持续两年的被称为“天梯大战”的大屠杀终于结束了。

和平条约的关键条款是组成统一战线对抗共同的敌人“天空堡垒”。随着[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始重建饱受战争蹂躏的星球，他们对未知的偏执和仇恨使得在未来与他们的互动更具挑战性。
descriptions.en:
In their efforts to construct "ladders to heaven," tensions between the [Root.GetPreFTLLower] nations of §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! led to an all-out global conflict. Fighting over ever-dwindling resources, the past two years of carnage known as the "Great Ladder Wars" have at last come to an end.

The key terms of the peace treaty are to present a united front against their common enemy, the "Sky Citadel." As the [event_target:pre_ftl_planet.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] rebuild their war-torn world, their increased paranoia and hatred of the unknown will make future interactions with them more challenging.

tooltips.zh: 观测站的£society£§Y社会学§!研究产出恢复正常
tooltips.en: The £society£ §YSociety§! Research output from the observation post returns to normal
